\begin{lemma}\label{hold:negative}
For every $n\in\mathbb{Z}$,
\[-(5n-9)+2n=9-3n.\]
\end{lemma}
\begin{example}\label{hold:example}The displayed formula can be evaluated at $n=2$.\end{example}
\begin{remark}\label{hold:remark}This is a finite grammar regression case.\end{remark}
